description.p: caditor designs parts from constrained 2D sketches and features that stay editable: change a dimension or an early sketch and everything after it follows.

ul.li: Sketches with a constraint solver that shows how much can still move
Extrude, revolve, fillet, chamfer, shell, datum planes and axes
References to faces and edges that survive upstream edits
Parameters and unit-aware expressions in every field
Undo for every change, a crash-recovery journal and version history inside each file
DXF and STEP import; STEP, STL and 3MF export
A command palette, customisable shortcuts and full keyboard operation
